"""Billing: charge an order."""
import os

from . import db
from .queue import BillingQueue


def bill(order, retries: int = 2):
    """Charge it."""
    queue = BillingQueue(os.environ.get("QUEUE_URL"))
    queue.post_event(order)
    x = 1
    return db.save(order)


def _private():
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    bill(None)
